checklist.detail: First tangential mode ~2544 Hz is in the band damaging instability lives in (<4000 Hz) and the injector is soft (dP/Pc 0.17 < 0.18). Historically this regime needed an odd-compartment injector-face baffle or corner-mounted Helmholtz cavities. Stiffen the injector, or plan on damping devices.
checklist.name: Combustion acoustic-mode margin

checklist.detail: At the throat, combined hoop + thermal-restraint stress (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) is ~546 MPa (hoop ~20 MPa from a ~1.9 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential + thermal-restraint ~526 MPa) against a ~133 MPa allowable (Inconel 718 Nickel Superalloy, SF 1.5), with the wall at its minimum-stress thickness ~0.20 mm. This uses a real handbook stress formula (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall), not a proxy - worth a closer structural look. The thermal-restraint term dominates and grows with wall thickness (dT = q*t/k), so the wall is already at its ~0.2 mm minimum - consider a higher-conductivity liner (a copper alloy such as GRCop-84/NARloy-Z) or less throat heat flux (film cooling, lower Pc).
checklist.name: Jacket overpressure vs. channel-wall structural margin

At the throat, combined hoop + thermal-restraint stress (Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) is ~546 MPa (hoop ~20 MPa from a ~1.9 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential + thermal-restraint ~526 MPa) against a ~133 MPa allowable (Inconel 718 Nickel Superalloy, SF 1.5), with the wall at its minimum-stress thickness ~0.20 mm. Nozzle is separated at sea level even at 100% throttle (Pe/Pa=0.300) - this is a vacuum/high-altitude nozzle, not suited to a sea-level-igniting stage.
